descriptionMarkdown:
# Bus Counter with a lil display. Instructions inside the blueprint. I gonna leave the previous counter on the bp book for learning purposes for everyone.
I'll be adding a proper liquid detector when I know how to do it properly.
Inside the blueprint book you have the previous counter I had and the new counter, much more modular and customizable.
A video of the circuit working:
Showcase Things to do:
A way to modularize the items for Bit Packing.
A counter with lamps (numbers).
Things that you say in the comments section if you have ideas.
V1
- Initial Release
V1.1
- Increased the amount of lamps for a better colour mapping.
- Now the average is divided by 9 to get the items throughput per second.
- Added an average per minute.
- Added an average of 4 on liquids.
- Fixed the screenshots now sending to imgur directly.
V1.2
ADDITIONS: - Remake of the logic.
- Added a dynamic lightning change depending on the throughput.
- Added an oscilloscope for each resource.
- Added a Bit Packing for each resource.
- Added the instructions on display panels. - Added a more an easier way to reduce or increase the items. REMOVED: - Removed previous logic. - Removed previous display.
- Lots and lots of tweaks while I was learning.
title: Bus Counter - Color mapping + Oscilloscope. V1.2
